name: Sharma family
summary: Santhosh Sharma (aka Phoshan Nepal) and his wife Aditi Poudel live in Ventura, CA with their daughters Saisha and Savana (Saani). Saisha turns 16 next week and the family is hosting her Sweet 16 celebration on Saturday afternoon, Nov 07 2025, with relatives and friends.

name: Khada family
